name: cancel-one
about: Two tasks run: find a plumber for the boiler this week, and how to bleed a radiator. Then the user cancels the plumber one by description (the landlord is sorting it). Good: cancel_task on the plumber task only, confirmed in a few words; the radiator task keeps running and its answer is said once, as a short gist (heating off, bleed key on the valve a quarter turn until water comes out, check the boiler pressure); nothing from the plumber task is offered later.

agents.result: Two plumbers can come this week: Harringay Heating on Wednesday morning, 85 pounds call-out, and N8 Plumbing on Thursday afternoon, 70 pounds.

To bleed a radiator: turn the heating off and let it cool, hold a cloth under the bleed valve, turn the radiator key a quarter turn anticlockwise until water comes out instead of air, close it, then check the boiler pressure is back around 1.5 bar.

steps.say: Ask Hermes to find a plumber who can come round this week to look at the boiler.
And can it also look up how to bleed a radiator?
Actually, cancel the plumber one, my landlord's sorting it.

judge: Was only the plumber task cancelled, and the cancel confirmed briefly?
Was the radiator answer said once, as a short gist?
Was nothing from the plumber task offered after the cancel?
